title: Bargaining with Absentmindedness
abstract: arXiv:2509.05828v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Delay is the norm in bargaining. I propose a novel source of bargaining delay: absentmindedness. Instead of interpreting absentmindedness as a literal memory friction, I use absentmindedness to represent a broader form of bounded rationality in dynamic games where players cannot perfectly track a game's progression. I show that equilibrium behavior is equivalent to that of a bargainer who commits ex-ante to a stationary behavioral strategy. Bargainers unable to finely condition play on the stage of dynamic interaction can credibly refuse last-minute ultimatums. Other parties that anticipate this behavior are driven to offer preemptive concessions to avoid a breakdown in negotiations. Absentmindedness is thus a source of bargaining power, even for players who never make offers. This bargaining power comes at the cost of efficiency; I show that there can be equilibria where offers are rejected on the path of play.

translated_abstract: 延迟是议价中的常态。我提出了议价延迟的一个新颖来源：健忘性。我没有将健忘性解释为字面意义上的记忆摩擦，而是用它来表示动态博弈中一种更广泛的有限理性形式，即参与者无法完美地追踪博弈的进程。我证明了均衡行为等价于一个事先承诺采用平稳行为策略的议价者的行为。无法根据动态互动的阶段精细调整策略的议价者，能够可信地拒绝最后通牒。而预期到这种行为的一方会被迫提出先发制人的让步，以避免谈判破裂。因此，健忘性是议价能力的一个来源，即使对于从不提出报价的参与者也是如此。然而这种议价能力是以效率为代价的；我证明了可能存在在均衡路径上报价遭到拒绝的均衡。
tldr: 这篇论文提出健忘性作为有限理性的一种形式，是议价延迟与议价能力的新来源——健忘的议价者能可信地拒绝最后通牒，迫使对方做出先发制人的让步，但这种议价能力以效率损失为代价。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes absentmindedness—a form of bounded rationality—as a novel source of bargaining delay and power: absentminded bargainers can credibly reject last-minute ultimatums and extract preemptive concessions from counterparts, though this bargaining power comes at the cost of efficiency.
